**Moved 36 calls in 12 files.**

All now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`. No `db.query` is left in `packages/`. Each file passes `node --check`.

One skipped: [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9). Its header says do not edit. Upgrades replace it wholesale.

`cache.query` calls are a separate API. Left as is.

Next: bump `legacy-orm` past 2.1.4 to clear the last two calls.
